tools.name: get_connection
tools.description: Check the Sloosh connection, spending status and the daily allowance left. Call once at the start of a conversation.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read a Sloosh guide by id: connection, spending, assets, generation, spaces, recovery, release-status.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List generation models for a mode (image_gen, video_gen, video_edit, video_extend) with their limits.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List assets already in the Sloosh workspace.

tools.name: import_asset
tools.description: Import an image from a public HTTPS URL into Sloosh. Returns the asset kind and id.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Get an asset and its current URL.

tools.name: quote_generation
tools.description: Quote image generation, video generation or video editing. Uses owned asset IDs and returns a single-use quote. Does not start work or debit credits. When warning is set, tell the user before they approve.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Start a paid generation for a quote. Needs quoteId, a stable idempotencyKey and confirmed=true after the user approves the quote.

tools.name: show_generation
tools.description: Show a generation or Space run in the result card. Pass operationId, or operationIds for up to 8 generations. Show a Space run on its own.

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Get the status and outputs of a generation.

tools.name: get_space
tools.description: Read a published Space by its exact ID.

tools.name: get_space_input_schema
tools.description: Read the current published form schema before preparing a Space run.

tools.name: quote_space
tools.description: Validate a published Space's inputs and obtain a single-use capped credit quote. Does not start work. When warning is set, tell the user before they approve.

tools.name: run_space
tools.description: Run a previously quoted published Space. Set confirmed=true only after the user approves this quote. Reuse one idempotencyKey for retries.

tools.name: get_space_run
tools.description: Read Space run state, pending checkpoints and final accounting. Poll until the run settles.

tools.name: get_space_run_outputs
tools.description: List a Space run's outputs as links, with each result's id, type, url and label.
